solutions.latex:
$$\begin{aligned} A&=\dfrac{1}{2}r^2\theta\\ &=\dfrac{1}{2}r^2\left(\dfrac{L-2r}{r}\right)\\ &=\dfrac{Lr}{2}-r^2 \end{aligned}$$

For maximum area, need $\dfrac{dA}{dr}=0$ and $\dfrac{d^2A}{dr^2}<0$

$$\begin{aligned} \dfrac{dA}{dr}&=\dfrac{L}{2}-2r\\ 0&=\dfrac{L}{2}-2r\\ 2r&=\dfrac{L}{2}\\ r&=\dfrac{L}{4} \end{aligned}$$

$$\dfrac{d^2A}{dr^2}=-2<0$$

Thus area is maximised when $r=\dfrac{L}{4}$

solutions.latex: $$\begin{aligned} \text{Area}&=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{6}}3\tan x\,dx+\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cot x\,dx\\ &=3\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{6}}\dfrac{\sin x}{\cos x}\,dx+\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\dfrac{\cos x}{\sin x}\,dx\\ &=-3\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{6}}\dfrac{-\sin x}{\cos x}\,dx+\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\dfrac{\cos x}{\sin x}\,dx\\ &=-3\Big[\ln|\cos x|\Big]_0^{\frac{\pi}{6}}+\Big[\ln|\sin x|\Big]_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\\ &=-3\left[\ln\left(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)-\ln(\cos 0)\right]+\left[\ln\left(\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)-\ln\left(\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)\right]\\ &=-3\left[\ln\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)-\ln(1)\right]+\left[\ln(1)-\ln\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)\right]\\ &=-3\ln\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)-\ln\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)\\ &=\ln\left(\dfrac{8}{3\sqrt{3}}\right)+\ln 2\\ &=\ln\left(\dfrac{16}{3\sqrt{3}}\right) \end{aligned}$$

solutions.latex:
Mode occurs at a maximum turning point. For stationary points, $f'(x)=0$.

$$\begin{aligned} f(x)&=\dfrac{\pi}{2+9\pi}\big(\sin(\pi x)+2x\big)\\ f'(x)&=\dfrac{\pi}{2+9\pi}\big(\pi\cos(\pi x)+2\big)\\ 0&=\pi\cos(\pi x)+2\\ \cos(\pi x)&=-\dfrac{2}{\pi}\\ \pi x&=\cos^{-1}\left(-\dfrac{2}{\pi}\right) \end{aligned}$$

\exfigure{335_q35_s2}

$$\begin{aligned} \text{Reference }\angle&=\cos^{-1}\left(\dfrac{2}{\pi}\right)\\ &=0.88068\ldots \end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned} \pi x&=\pi-0.88,\ \pi+0.88,\ 3\pi-0.88,\ 3\pi+0.88,\ \ldots\\ &=2.2609,\ 4.0222,\ 8.5440,\ 10.3054,\ \ldots\\ x&=0.72,\ 1.28,\ 2.72,\ 3.28,\ \ldots \end{aligned}$$

But $0\le x\le 3$, and from the graph the mode is the third stationary point.

$\therefore$ mode is $x=2.72$
